literal: Goodness of mind to enduring lives (is) prosperity; goodness of company all fame will give.
translation: Goodness of mind brings prosperity to living beings, but goodness of company will bring them every kind of fame.
modern: ஒருவருக்கு மனத்தின் நலம் செல்வத்தைத் தரும்; ஆனால் அவர் சேர்ந்திருக்கும் இனத்தின் நலம் அவருக்கு எல்லாப் புகழையும் தேடித்தரும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the benefits of a good mind with those of good company. While having a good mind brings personal prosperity and well-being to a person, associating with good company elevates them further. Good company brings universal praise and all kinds of fame. The poet emphasizes that while internal goodness is essential for success, the right social circle is what secures lasting honor and reputation.
